summary: ACDE #245 把 frame 交易（EIP-8141）定为 Hegotá 的执行层头条，并把 14 个 EIP 列为拒绝纳入（DFI），其中包括账户抽象相关的 EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE 和 EIP-7851 代码控制的 EOA 委托。Vitalik 发帖指出 PBT 把合约代码按 codehash 单独存储，可以借机理顺 EIP-7702、SETCODEFROM 等多种代码委托方式。Ethlabs、L2BEAT、ethbeat 相继发布 Hegotá 排名。

items.title: vdWijden：今天 ACD 做了出人意料理性的决定
items.note: ACDE #245 21:00（据 Ethereal news #39）：EIP-8141 frame 交易定为 Hegotá 头条；14 个 EIP 被列为 DFI，账户抽象方面是 EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE 指令和 EIP-7851 代码控制的 EOA 委托，EVM 方面有 EIP-8182 私密 ETH 和 ERC-20 转账等，定价方面有 EIP-8358 账户变更的净 gas 计量等。EIP-7979、EIP-8163、EIP-8372、EIP-8304 推迟决定，默认 DFI。vdWijden：今天 ACD 做了出人意料理性的决定 22:17。
items.title_en: vdWijden: a surprisingly rational decision made on ACD today
items.note_en: ACDE #245 at 21:00 (per Ethereal news #39): EIP-8141 frame transactions were set as the Hegotá headliner; 14 EIPs were DFI, including the account abstraction proposals EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE instruction and EIP-7851 code-controlled EOA delegation, EVM proposals such as EIP-8182 private ETH and ERC-20 transfers, and pricing proposals such as EIP-8358 net gas metering for account changes. Decisions on EIP-7979, EIP-8163, EIP-8372 and EIP-8304 were delayed, defaulting to DFI. vdWijden: a surprisingly rational decision made on ACD today, 22:17.

items.title: Magicians：分区二叉树与代码委托的未来
items.note: 22:51（vbuterin）。PBT（EIP-8297）把合约代码放进按 codehash 索引的独立树。EIP-7702 用一段 23 字节序列表示委托；EIP-8141 让委托需求更多；SETCODEFROM（EIP-8298）允许合约把代码设为另一地址的代码而无需重新部署。Hegotá 之后将有三种方式让账户使用已上链的大段代码，PBT 的新代码格式是一次统一清理的机会。
items.title_en: Magicians: partitioned binary trees and the future of code delegation
items.note_en: 22:51 (vbuterin). PBT (EIP-8297) stores contract code in a separate tree indexed by codehash. EIP-7702 uses a 23-byte sequence to mean delegation; EIP-8141 creates more demand for delegation; SETCODEFROM (EIP-8298) lets a contract set its code to another address's code without redeploying it. After Hegotá there would be three ways for an account to use large code already onchain, and PBT's new code format is a chance for a clean fix.
items.topic_en: ACDE #245 and the direction of account abstraction

items.title: EIP-8037：把交易 gas 上限封顶在 2^32-1
items.note: （chfast，9 月 14 日合并）。EIP-7825 的上限只作用于执行 gas，`tx.gas` 便只受区块 gas 上限约束；新上限 `TX_MAX_TOTAL_GAS_LIMIT` 为 4,294,967,295，留出约 2.8 MB 的代码部署预算，约为 EIP-7954 合约大小上限的 43 倍。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: cap the transaction gas limit at 2^32-1
items.note_en: (chfast, merged September 14). EIP-7825's cap applied to execution gas alone, leaving `tx.gas` bounded only by the block gas limit; the new `TX_MAX_TOTAL_GAS_LIMIT` of 4,294,967,295 leaves a code-deposit budget of roughly 2.8 MB, about 43 times the EIP-7954 contract size limit.

summary_en: ACDE #245 set frame transactions (EIP-8141) as Hegotá's execution layer headliner and Declined for Inclusion (DFI) 14 EIPs, including the account abstraction proposals EIP-7819 SETDELEGATE and EIP-7851 code-controlled EOA delegation. Vitalik posted that PBT stores contract code separately by codehash, a chance to clean up the multiple code delegation methods such as EIP-7702 and SETCODEFROM. Ethlabs, L2BEAT and ethbeat released Hegotá rankings.
